👵 Andy Burnham has reversed Labour's winter fuel payment cuts — a welcome climbdown, and an admission the cut was a mistake.

The catch: pensioners earning over £35,000 will have it clawed back automatically by HMRC, via tax code changes or self-assessment. A universal payment shouldn't need an opt-out form.
